# `aitbc dispute user`

List the disputes an address is party to.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc dispute user [OPTIONS] USER_ADDRESS
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `user_address` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain node RPC URL |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc dispute user USER_ADDRESS
```
